title: TR: Textures Reimagined
description: Textures Reimagined (tr) is a pack that have better textures for any block in minecraft (version 1.0 just wood textures).
body:
**Elevate your Minecraft worlds with Textures Reimagined, clean resource pack that reimagines every single block in minecraft. From the rugged cracks of stone to the shimmering veins of emerald ore, no block escapes this meticulous redesign—delivering 100% coverage across vanilla Minecraft _(1.20+ compatible)._**

 > Made by Minecraft Modders, each block features:

 - Realistic details: Enhanced shading, cleaner textures, details and many more!

 - Seamless cohesion: Unified art direction blending modern realism with classic Minecraft charm—no mismatched eyesores.

 - Performance optimized: Lightweight files (16x resolution default) ensuring smooth FPS on mid-range rigs.

 - Custom variants: Connected textures for glass, paths, and more, plus emissive glows for lava, glowstone, and redstone **(coming soon)**.

 **Perfect for builders, survivalists, and redstone engineers seeking that "pro" edge. Installs in seconds via Minecraft's resource pack menu—pairs flawlessly with shaders like Complementary or BSL.**

 Over 81 unique block textures for now, every day creating new ones. Download now and redefine your builds!


> **Newer versions may need Entity Texture and entity model features!**
